questions.question: What is a sustainable job opportunity? Give three features.
questions.expected_answer: A job that can continue over a long time. Features (any three): lasts over time; pays a fair, decent income (at least minimum wage); safe working conditions and fair treatment; does not destroy the environment or natural resources; based on goods/services people keep wanting.

questions.question: Explain why SMMEs are important for job creation and name two challenges they face.
questions.expected_answer: SMMEs create a large share of new jobs and income, including in the informal sector; entrepreneurs who grow businesses employ others. Challenges (any two): access to finance; lack of business skills; competition from big business; red tape; crime; unreliable electricity.

questions.question: Describe one way each of government, business and the community can help create jobs, and give one example of a green job.
questions.expected_answer: Government: infrastructure (power, roads), skills and education, support agencies, public works. Business: invest, expand, train, buy from small suppliers, YES internships. Community: buy local, form cooperatives and stokvels. Green job e.g.: installing solar panels, recycling, clearing alien plants (Working for Water), eco-tourism.
